# SYNESIS_E100 — Warning

## Description

Invalid GENERATED_AT `value` (ISO 8601 with time zone).

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: `GENERATED_AT value` is not an ISO 8601 date with a time zone.
  Example: `GENERATED_AT 2026-11-16T12:00:00Z` or `...T12:00:00-03:00`.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **InvalidGeneratedAt**: `block`, `value`
